note: Where each picture in src/assets/img/source/ came from, and what the Credits page says about it. They are old prints, free to use: in the public domain, or shared by their museum under CC0 (no rights kept). 'subject' is how the Credits page names the picture ('the orrery'), 'title', 'artist' and 'year' describe the work, 'collection' is who keeps the original and shares the scan, 'licence' is Public domain, CC0 or Unsplash License, and 'url' is the picture's own page. The build stops if a picture is used without an entry here, or if an entry lacks one of these. A picture marked "credit": false in images.json needs no entry here. The drawings (the .svg files) are the site's own and need no entry.
